Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util

Class ForgeFluidStacks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.ForgeFluidStacks
public final class ForgeFluidStacks extends Object
Boundary conversions between Forge's fluid value and the loader-neutral persisted representation.

Forge's FluidStack carries its variant payload as a CompoundTag; the loader-neutral value carries a DataComponentPatch. The tag travels as the patch's DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA component, the same place vanilla keeps free-form item NBT. The helper surface mirrors neoforge/.../util/NeoForgeFluidStacks so fluid-logic changes stay diff-clean between the two loaders.
